verdict.rationale: First-party material describes Scheduled Tasks: you define a cron schedule and agents start and run autonomously in the background. The docs also mention scheduling messages to agents while you are away, and a headless CLI that can be scripted and integrated into CI pipelines. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on scheduled-task configuration and management (run history, failure handling, where scheduled jobs execute), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduling works as described.
